chk_daily_attendance_non_negative.name: chk_daily_attendance_non_negative
chk_daily_attendance_non_negative.value:
"daily_attendance"."worked_minutes" >= 0 AND "daily_attendance"."night_minutes" >= 0 AND "daily_attendance"."late_minutes" >= 0
           AND "daily_attendance"."early_leave_minutes" >= 0 AND "daily_attendance"."absent_minutes" >= 0
           AND "daily_attendance"."ot_weekday_minutes" >= 0 AND "daily_attendance"."ot_weekend_minutes" >= 0
           AND "daily_attendance"."ot_holiday_minutes" >= 0 AND "daily_attendance"."ot_night_minutes" >= 0
           AND "daily_attendance"."regularized_minutes" >= 0 AND "daily_attendance"."punch_count" >= 0

chk_employee_shifts_rotation.name: chk_employee_shifts_rotation
chk_employee_shifts_rotation.value: "employee_shifts"."rotation_code" IS NULL OR ("employee_shifts"."anchor_date" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_shifts"."team_index" IS NOT NULL)

chk_policy_active_requires_approval.name: chk_policy_active_requires_approval
chk_policy_active_requires_approval.value: "policy_versions"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR ("policy_versions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "policy_versions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

chk_raw_punches_coords.name: chk_raw_punches_coords
chk_raw_punches_coords.value: "raw_punches"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("raw_punches"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "raw_punches"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)
